d:
Presenting a gem of a track which is powerful to unearth many emotions as you keep listening to it! "Ravil" by Sushin Shyam from the much awaited super hero movie 'Minnal Murali' definitely warrants repeated plays and it will leave an everlasting impression in your hearts!
Music Composed and Arranged: Sushin Shyam
Singer: Pradeep Kumar
Lyrics: Manu Manjith
Strings: Chennai Ensemble
Song Mixed and Mastered by: Abin Paul
Song Recorded at 2BQ
Recording Engineer: Divine Joseph Antony
